How do I use it properly the very first time?
Even though all of our sheets are pre-washed prior to purchase, we recommend washing them once before your very first use.
For best results, wash them on a cold, gentle cycle using a liquid detergent (such as our Gentle Wash Laundry Concentrate). Limit tumble-drying to low heat, avoid overloading the machine, and skip any bleach, brighteners, or dry-cleaning.
